decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's equation family under catherine-6g2 taken to full verification at the 8 GB / 300 s standard: the declared unwind sized to the shape's concrete loop bounds (8, the per-harness precedent), the family's sort relocated from the partition entry into the check harness (per-family emission order is already key order; the merged cross-family sort lives in engine_families), and the witness claim split per composition side (soundness_equation lhs, soundness_equation_rhs rhs; 17 declared harnesses).
decision.rationale: The lane extends: the equation family — the check walk's panic/overflow freedom and both halves of every emitted violation's independent re-derivation — is fully verified. The measured ladder, each rung a recorded lever: (1) the declared unwind 8 halved the unrolled formula mass (every executed loop is concretely bounded by 8 under the shape) and check_equation_panic_freedom proved immediately — 2:00.79 wall, 4.94 GB peak, symex 26.2 s, 4 061 VCCs after slicing, 16 solver instances; soundness_equation at unwind 8 alone was not enough (8 757 VCCs, killed at the solver handoff). (2) Relocating the sort into the check harness (the entry emits in walk order, already key order) dropped soundness_equation to 6 057 VCCs and got it into the solver, but it still lost the growth race at the cap — the both-sides obligation's two independent composes are its mass. (3) The claim split per composition side finished it: soundness_equation (lhs) proved at 5:11.59 wall / 5.84 GB peak (symex 18.2 s, 4 745 VCCs, 29 solver instances) and soundness_equation_rhs proved at 2:25.79 wall / 5.84 GB (symex 16.0 s, 4 745 VCCs, 14 solver instances). The lane's proof count stands at 9 of 17 declared. The 0008 mechanism stands unchanged — the solve loop's memory grows per property toward the cap, and these partitions fit only in the smallest claim units (the both-sides obligation at 6 057 post-slicing VCCs did not fit). The --slice-formula probe's negative result and the 0004 retirement extension stand. Contract suite (633 tests), clippy -D warnings, fmt, ah check, and ledger-check all green; the eight earlier proofs and the parsed surface are untouched.
holes_found: six harnesses remain undetermined (check/soundness key, coproduct, pullback; the all-families walk; the all-families build); their recorded path is the same ladder — per-family partition, findings arena, declared unwind sized to the shape's concrete loop bounds, sort relocated to the order-needing claims, claim split per composition side — recorded, not funded

the solve-loop growth mechanism (ledger 0008) bounds how large any single claim unit may grow at this standard; a toolchain release whose per-property loop stops growing remains the trigger for re-consolidating split claims
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The fixture corpus and the contract suite pin the parsed surface byte-identically — the sort relocation and claim split touch only lane-only entries and harness obligations. Cost: one unwind-8 round (one proof, one solve-phase kill), one sort-relocation round (one re-proof, one solver-handoff kill), one per-side split round (two proofs).
